generation_notes: Rebuilt this PK-only batch as exactly four source-grounded IEC 60870-5-104 APDU seeds to avoid the prior 101/104 hybrid errors. Supplied sources explicitly cover the 0x68 IEC 60870-5-104 start byte, U-format frame types, TypeIDs including C_SC_NA_1 and C_DC_NA_1, Cause of Transmission values including test and confirmation semantics, and interrogation qualifier 20 for station interrogation. Where the sources were incomplete on exact APDU field packing, conservative model-prior completion was used for standard 104 APCI/I-format and U-format layouts without contradicting supplied evidence. Length octets were recalculated to match each frame exactly. The four seeds are intentionally distinct across U-format control, stateful U+I exchange, control command TypeID 45, and monitoring/report TypeID 5 with spontaneous COT 3 to improve parser and state coverage while preserving valid frame relationships.

Stateful IEC 60870-5-104 sequence combining STARTDT activation/confirmation with a valid General Interrogation I-format ASDU using TypeID 100 and QOI 20

Monitoring-direction I-format report coverage using TypeID 5 M_ST_NA_1 with spontaneous cause
